4. SMS messaging terms

Program name: Algarithm Booking Updates

What we send: If you opt in, Algarithm will text you about your booked call, including booking confirmations, reminders 24 hours and 1 hour before your call, the link to join, and information about our marketing services for clinics.

How you opt in: You opt in by ticking the optional SMS consent box when you request or book a call with us, for example through our Facebook or Instagram lead form or our booking page. The box is unchecked by default. Consent to receive text messages is not a condition of booking a call or buying any service.

Message frequency: Message frequency varies. You will typically receive up to 4 messages per booked call.

Costs: Message and data rates may apply, depending on your mobile plan.

Opting out: Reply STOP to any message at any time to stop receiving texts. We will send one message confirming that you have been unsubscribed, and you will receive no further texts unless you opt in again. You can also opt out by emailing info@algarithm.co.uk.

Help: Reply HELP to any message for help, or email info@algarithm.co.uk.

Carriers: Mobile carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

Your information: We do not sell, rent or share your mobile number, SMS opt-in data or text messaging consent with any third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. For more detail, see our Privacy Policy at us.algarithm.co.uk/privacy/.
